title: Unsloth LoRA / QLoRA Fine-Tuning
description: Fine-tune Hugging Face LLMs with Unsloth (LoRA or 4-bit QLoRA SFT) from a chat or alpaca dataset. Returns a LoRA adapter on your network volume, optionally pushed to the Hugging Face Hub. Long jobs run as async /run requests with checkpoints and resume.

input.name: Base model
input.description: Hugging Face model to fine-tune (owner/name). Unsloth '-bnb-4bit' repos download fastest for QLoRA. Can be overridden per job with input.base_model.

input.name: Dataset
input.description: Default training data: a Hugging Face dataset id (owner/name) or an http(s) URL to .jsonl/.json/.csv/.parquet. Can be overridden per job with input.dataset.

input.name: Dataset format
input.description: chat = 'messages'/'conversations' lists (OpenAI or ShareGPT style); alpaca = instruction/input/output; auto = detect.

input.name: QLoRA (4-bit base model)
input.description: On = QLoRA (least VRAM). Off = 16-bit LoRA (needs roughly 2-3x more VRAM).

input.name: Epochs
input.description: Passes over the dataset. Ignored when Max steps > 0.

input.name: Max steps (0 = use epochs)
input.description: Hard cap on optimizer steps. Use e.g. 30 for a quick smoke test.

input.name: LoRA rank (r)
input.description: Adapter capacity. 8-64 is typical; higher uses more VRAM.

input.name: LoRA alpha
input.description: Scaling factor; Unsloth recommends alpha = r.

input.name: Max sequence length
input.description: Tokens per example; longer rows are truncated.

input.name: Gradient accumulation
input.description: Effective batch = batch size x this.

input.name: Learning rate
input.description: Default 2e-4 works for most LoRA runs.

input.name: Output HF repo (optional)
input.description: Push the adapter to this Hugging Face repo (owner/name) at the end of a successful run. Requires the HF_TOKEN secret. Leave empty to keep the adapter on the network volume only.

input.name: Private HF repo
input.description: Create the output repo as private.

input.name: Hugging Face token (use a Runpod secret)
input.description: Do NOT paste a raw token. Create a Runpod secret (e.g. hf_token) and enter {{ RUNPOD_SECRET_hf_token }}. Needed for gated/private models and for pushing the adapter.

input.name: Checkpoint every N steps
input.description: Checkpoints go to the network volume so an interrupted job can resume.

input.name: Chat template
input.description: 'auto' uses the model's own template. Otherwise an Unsloth template name such as chatml, llama-3.1, qwen-2.5, gemma-3.

input.name: Output directory
input.description: Default: /runpod-volume/unsloth-finetune when a network volume is attached.

input.name: Worker init timeout (s)
input.description: Large image; allow time for the first pull.
